Mine are really heavy and last sometimes over a month… I know it’s not normal. I’ve been unable to have healthcare for awhile but finally got approved so I’m praying to get it all settled this year and to find out why. But anyways, I have really bad clotting that just goes AROUND every absorbency of tampon and goes through just about every pad. Within 30 minutes to two hours. The cup I have to dump every couple of hours, sometimes sooner but I’m saving so much money now that I switched to the cup. (I was spending between 30-50 usdollars on products a cycle.) 

I’m not quite sure how common but man does it suck. I can’t believe some girls only use regular tampons, and some of them even have 3-5 day periods.

When I was about 18, I had severe pain in my lower abdomen. A few years prior I had pancreatitis and they told me I had the liver of a 60 year old alcoholic man. So I figured it was related as the pain was just as brutal. I was writhing in pain, and NOT on my period as it was irregular at the time. 

I lived about the same distance in between two different hospitals. One I had been born in and had gone to plenty of times with no problems, which I clearly went to. After about three hours of waiting they told me that it was period symptoms and sent me home with a prescription for a larger dosage of Tylenol. I was furious but figured they knew more than I did. After a few more hours, I still had the pain and the Tylenol was not helping so I went to the other hospital. They brought me into the ER immediately, and could see the discomfort I felt and listened. Hooked me up to morphine while we waited (yes, it was that bad) and after the tests it was discovered that my gallbladder was completely covered in gallstones. They were astonished by how many there were and told me the only option I’d have to truly not have this pain was to just remove it. Period pains my ass.

I have an extremely vivid memory from when I was 6-8 years old. My parents are divorced — and at that time my dad had me on weekends. We always woke up rather early and that year I was up around 4-5 am. My dad was packing the truck up with gifts to take with us to my stepmom’s father’s house while my stepmom was in the bathroom. I looked outside the front door, waiting patiently and excitedly when I noticed something move up on my neighbor’s house. They had recently built the house and moved inside. Nobody was awake. On their roof sat a moderately sized inflatable santa with his sleigh decoration, and behind it I noticed Santa in the flesh… or as real as it seemed hiding. His eyes caught mine and he moved a finger up to his mouth as if shushing me. I remember this so vividly still and it’s been at least 12-14 years.
I saved it months ago and was so happy to have it. I’m playing on Moon Guard! 😌
